chapter: Solo years, marriages and the Canadian party
title: Meeting her in London during Memories of Jolson
summary: He met the dancer in England while she rehearsed for the show and persuaded her not to quit.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: This is the first woman that was also a performer as well as yourself?
While you were over in Germany at that time.

Mh-hm -- was it Germany, yes, it was Germany. Oh, no, no, sorry, not it wasn't in Germany, no, I'm sorry, it wasn't Germany. I met her in England because I'd gone from Germany to England to do theshow "Memories of Jolson" and she was rehearsing for the show and I think it was the piano player who was colored who was a friend of hers, as a

platonic friend, in my best estimation, and he introduced me to her and she was telling me during a break of rehearsal that she'd been rehearsing with shows and so forth and she come to tell me about that they didn't want to give her something, she'd been rehearsing with the show right along for some length of time and now they want to take her out and they don't want to give her the chance to go with the show for two weeks. Well, she wants to quit the show. I said, you don't know what you are if you're going to quit. If you go on with the show you'll get to learn what the audience is like and you get to learn what you can do and how you go over. But don't quit now you've been doing this right along. So let this be the time that you're going to learn something. So she stayed with the show.
